source_notes.description: The 'Previous Month' columns are headed 'IPC' while the current month and current year are headed 'IPC + BNS'. Values are stored as printed; month-to-month comparisons may mix legal frameworks.
The cyber table's 'PA' column is not defined in the source. It is stored under the metric name 'pa' without interpretation.
The brothel statement is titled 'zonewise' but contains only a Mumbai TOTAL row; no zone breakdown is available.
The NDPS 'Values' column does not state its currency or unit.
Cough Syrup's quantity 123.20 is printed in the Kgs column, while both total rows list 123.20 under litres. Stored as printed (quantity_kg).
The statement is city-level only: no incident records, timestamps, coordinates, police-station or zone breakdown. It cannot train a spatial or temporal model on its own.
